outcome: A DomainSpec author or implementation owner can compile exact authored meta-type meaning into deterministic native realizations and receive causal evidence when target behavior violates the selected semantic and relationship obligations.

DS-D1 formation and DS-D8 relationship obligations
deterministic compilation and TypeScript, Python, and Rust realization bindings
bounded native runtime observation, formal projection, and conformance evidence
exclusions: the 11 UI candidate and supporting types
inventing missing business algorithms or provider behavior
publication, release, deployment, production, or external effects

input_contracts.meaning: One exact DomainSpec v2 source graph with typed meta-types, authored bodies, and DS-D8 relationships.
One exact language profile and immutable predecessor or successor realization identity.

output_contracts.meaning: A deterministic compiled graph and system ontology preserving the selected obligations.
Digest-bound native and formal observations that preserve PASS, FAIL, unsupported, stale, and not_evaluable as distinct outcomes.

context_policies.meaning: All meaning, compiler, generated, runtime, formal, and evidence identities belong to one frozen source epoch.
A generator may not invent copy, sum, truthiness, index-selection, identity, transition, or effect semantics absent an exact authored carrier.

owner_routes.owner: Owner of the consuming DomainSpec project

realization_bindings.claim_limit: Command-surface admission does not prove semantic preservation or formal adequacy.

obligations.statement: Every executable behavior is sourced from exact authored meaning or an exact external implementation binding.
All applicable DS-D8 endpoint, cardinality, inverse, scope, ordering, projection, and project-wide closure rules remain fail-closed.
Two materializations of identical inputs are byte-identical.
TypeScript, Python, and Rust agree on every selected positive and hostile runtime outcome.
Formation, compilation, runtime observation, formal proof, conformance, admission, and deployment remain separate claims.

revision_history.change: Adopted by direct owner instruction for the meta-type implementation-depth execution frontier.

challenge_route: Challenge product meaning through the DomainSpec v2 owner, DS-D1 and DS-D8 meaning through the language owner, package behavior through the CLI owner, and conformance claims through an independent reviewer.
claim_limit: This adoption owns the product outcome and D65 predecessor boundary. It does not prove any implementation layer conformant and grants no publication, release, deployment, production, or external-effect authority.
